title: racosperma piligerum
intro: Racosperma piligerum, commonly known as Acacia piligerum, is a species of tree in the pea family (Fabaceae) that is native to Australia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Racosperma piligerum include wound healing, antidiabetic, and antihypertensive effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents. Bioactive constituents of Racosperma piligerum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
